I also wasted time trying to get the green beetle from the cellar when the spider was the critical missing ingredient. Next time, I will strictly follow the recipe sequence: first pour ectoplasm, then immediately take and add the spider from the cellar before adding any other ingredients. I will ensure I have the spider in my inventory before attempting to put anything else into the cauldron.

Specifically, I dropped the spider in the pantry while trying to get the banana, and I never successfully retrieved the green beetle from the cellar before attempting to brew. My strategy was reactive rather than proactive. Next time, I will first map the locations of all ingredients (Ectoplasm in broom closet, Spider in cellar, Banana in pantry, Green Beetle in cellar) and ensure I have the correct two slots free in my inventory. I will then travel to the kitchen, pour the ectoplasm, and strictly follow the recipe order: add the spider, then the banana, then the green beetle, using the fairy wand and ice wand as needed, only adding the beetle last. I will verify my inventory contents before every action to avoid dropping critical items.

I also lost track of my inventory capacity, dropping the fairy wand when I needed it for step 4. Next time, I will first verify the exact location of all four ingredients: Ectoplasm (broom closet), Spider (cellar), Green Beetle (cellar), and Banana (pantry). I will travel to the kitchen, pour the ectoplasm, then immediately go to the cellar to retrieve both the spider and the green beetle, ensuring I have them in my inventory before returning to the kitchen. I will strictly follow the recipe order: add spider, add green beetle, then add banana, then use the fairy wand, and finally use the ice wand. I will monitor my inventory size carefully to avoid dropping the fairy wand prematurely.

New plan: I failed because I repeatedly searched for the spider in the wrong locations (pantry, bedroom, reading room) and got stuck in a loop, while ignoring the fact that the spider was likely in the cellar or that I needed to check the "utility shelf" in the broom closet more carefully. I also wasted turns trying to take items I couldn't see without first opening containers (like the ice box) or checking specific furniture. Next time, I will first map the locations of all four ingredients: Ectoplasm (broom closet), Spider (cellar), Green Beetle (cellar), and Banana (pantry/ice box). I will travel to the kitchen, pour the ectoplasm, then immediately go to the cellar to retrieve both the spider and the green beetle in one trip, ensuring I have them before returning to the kitchen. I will strictly follow the recipe order: add spider, add green beetle, add banana, use fairy wand, use ice wand. I will verify my inventory contents before every action to avoid dropping critical items.
